title: Seetha denounces Ravana's misdeeds
introduction: Seetha denounces Ravana's misdeed and challenges him to brave her husband in a manly combat, rather than thieving her in a mousy way. She reasons with him about his propriety in abducting other's wives, in vainglory.
closing: "Am I conquered by you in a combat between my husband and you, wherein you on announcing your name to my husband and truly showing your audacious audacity defeated my husband, and thus triumphing over me - or what? Tell me, you mousy demon...
इति वाल्मीकि रामायणे आदि काव्ये अरण्य काण्डे त्रि पंचाशः सर्गः

verses.devanagari:
खम् उत्पतन्तम् तम् दृष्ट्वा मैथिली जनक आत्मजा |
दुःखिता परम उद्विग्ना भये महति वर्तिनी
verses.iast:
kham utpatantam tam dṛṣṭvā maithilī janaka ātmajā |
duḥkhitā parama udvignā bhaye mahati vartinī
verses.translation: Maithili, the daughter of Janaka, on seeing the skyward flight of Ravana taking her along became highly frantic and remaining in highest dismay she is distraught.

glosses.meaning: on sky, up, fallen [Ravana's taking flight along with her,] him, on seeing

verses.devanagari:
रोष रोदन ताम्राक्षी भीमाक्षम् राक्षस अधिपम् |
रुदती करुणम् सीता ह्रियमाणा इदम् अब्रवीत्
verses.iast:
roṣa rodana tāmrākṣī bhīmākṣam rākṣasa adhipam |
rudatī karuṇam sītā hriyamāṇā idam abravīt
verses.translation: Seetha whose eyes turned coppery-red with tears and resentment, still outpouring tears while being abducted she piteously poured this scorn on that gory-eyed demon's chief, Ravana.

glosses.meaning: with resentment, tearful, coppery, eyed one
terrible [gory,] eyed one, to demon's, chief
piteously, this, said [poured scorn on Ravana.]

verses.devanagari:
न व्यपत्रपसे नीच कर्मणा अनेन रावण |
ज्ञात्वा विरहिताम् यो माम् चोरयित्वा पलायसे
verses.iast:
na vyapatrapase nīca karmaṇā anena rāvaṇa |
GYātvā virahitām yo mām corayitvā palāyase
verses.translation: "You knave Ravana, you are taking flight on thieving me after prowling about my loneliness, such as you are, are you not ashamed in the least for this subterfuge.

glosses.meaning: me, on thieving, you took to flight
not, [very, lowly, ashamed] = are you not ashamed in the least.

verses.devanagari:
त्वया एव नूनम् दुष्टात्मन् भीरुणा हर्तुम् इच्छता |
मम अपवाहितो भर्ता मृग रूपेण मायया
verses.iast:
tvayā eva nūnam duṣṭātman bhīruṇā hartum icchatā |
mama apavāhito bhartā mṛga rūpeṇa māyayā
verses.translation: "You black-hearted fiend, for sure, you alone sidelined my husband in a trickish guise of Golden Deer wishful to abduct me as you are a coward.

glosses.meaning: by trickery, in a Golden-Deer's, guise
to side, lined - led away from hermitage

verses.devanagari:
यो हि माम् उद्यतः त्रातुम् सो अपि अयम् विनिपातितः |
गृध्र राजः पुराणो असौ श्वशुरस्य सखा मम
verses.iast:
yo hi mām udyataḥ trātum so api ayam vinipātitaḥ |
gṛdhra rājaḥ purāṇo asau śvaśurasya sakhā mama
verses.translation: "Which king of eagles battled against you to bail me out, an old friend of my father-in-law, such as he is he is also felled, indeed.
notes: Annex: 'You have felled an old and withered eagle after a long-drawn battle... then, how long can you battle that Raghava? Does this felling of an age-old eagle adds any feather to your crown?'

verses.devanagari:
परमम् खलु ते वीर्यम् दृश्यते राक्षसाधम |
विश्राव्य नामधेयम् हि युद्धे न अस्मि जिता त्वया
verses.iast:
paramam khalu te vīryam dṛśyate rākṣasādhama |
viśrāvya nāmadheyam hi yuddhe na asmi jitā tvayā
verses.translation: "Ah, truly what an audacious audacity is shown by you... you basely demon... by ear-shattering your great name saying that 'I am Ravana...' I am conquered in a combat - Really?

glosses.meaning: [your great] name, making to listen [earbashing, ear-shattering,]

glosses.itrans: tvayaa yuddhe na jitaa asmi hi
glosses.iast: tvayā yuddhe na jitā asmi hi
glosses.devanagari: त्वया युद्धे न जिता अस्मि हि
glosses.meaning: by you, in combat, not, conquered, I am, really
by combating, I am, conquered, by you - Really? Or, yuddhe naamadheyam vishraavya = in combat, you name, on announcing.]

verses.devanagari:
ईदृशम् गर्हितम् कर्म कथम् कृत्वा न लज्जसे |
स्त्रियाः च हरणम् नीच रहिते च परस्य च
verses.iast:
īdṛśam garhitam karma katham kṛtvā na lajjase |
striyāḥ ca haraṇam nīca rahite ca parasya ca
verses.translation: "A woman, that too a lonely one, that too the other man's wife, that too an abduction, but not winning or wooing her... you knave, on your undertaking such a kind of deplorable deed, how unashamed are you?
notes: Annex: 'Will not the other males deplore you for your unmasculine female stealing, for this kind of undertaking is unobserved even in animal world?'

verses.devanagari:
कथयिष्यन्ति लोकेषु पुरुषाः कर्म कुत्सितम् |
सुनृशंसम् अधर्मिष्ठम् तव शौण्डीर्य मानिनः
verses.iast:
kathayiṣyanti lokeṣu puruṣāḥ karma kutsitam |
sunṛśaṃsam adharmiṣṭham tava śauṇḍīrya māninaḥ
verses.translation: "A self-glorifier as you are, this highly inhuman, iniquitous, imputable deed of yours will be recounted by all men in all worlds.
notes: Annex: 'For this is an unmanly action of yours, all the manly men wish to recount this as a fabulously fabled account, in dissent, for exemplification of their manliness and also to retroject your self-vainglory...'

glosses.meaning: glorious, self-admirer [self-glorification, or self-vain-glorification] tava = of yours
in world, men, wish to recount.

verses.devanagari:
धिक् ते शौर्यम् च सत्त्वम् च यत् त्वया कथितम् तदा |
कुल आक्रोशकरम् लोके धिक् ते चारित्रम् ईदृशम्
verses.iast:
dhik te śauryam ca sattvam ca yat tvayā kathitam tadā |
kula ākrośakaram loke dhik te cāritram īdṛśam
verses.translation: "Damn with what you have said then about your might and mettle... damn with this kind of your demeanour which is lamentable to whole of your clan in this world.
notes: Annex: 'You were boastful of your triumphs and victories at the time of captivating me, damn with them... since there is not an iota of gallantry in thieving me, a lonely one in the thick of the forests... and this misdemeanour of yours which not only ruins you but becomes a lamentable affair to whole of your clan, while being burnt in the infernos of Raghava's arrows...'

verses.devanagari:
किम् शक्यम् कर्तुम् एवम् हि यत् जवेन एव धावसि |
मुहूर्तम् अपि तिष्ठस्व न जीवन् प्रतियास्यसि
verses.iast:
kim śakyam kartum evam hi yat javena eva dhāvasi |
muhūrtam api tiṣṭhasva na jīvan pratiyāsyasi
verses.translation: "What can be done possibly... why because you are fleeing very speedily in this way... wait for a moment to ascertain whether you can go back in aliveness...
notes: Annex: 'You are fleeing as though death is haunting you... death is at your behind... wait, wait and stay... it will approach you speedily... when death nears you, let us watchfully ascertain whose is glory or whose is vainglory... between your Death similar Raghava and deadened you...'

glosses.meaning: what, to do, possible - what can be done possibly
this way, speedily, thus, you are fleeing
for moment, even, stay [wait, to ascertain]
in aliveness, not [whether,] back, you can go

verses.devanagari:
न हि चक्षुः पथम् प्राप्य तयोः पार्थिव पुत्रयोः |
स सैन्यो अपि समर्थः त्वम् मुहूर्तम् अपि जीवितुम्
verses.iast:
na hi cakṣuḥ patham prāpya tayoḥ pārthiva putrayoḥ |
sa sainyo api samarthaḥ tvam muhūrtam api jīvitum
verses.translation: "On your coming into the line of sight of those two princes, even if you are with whole of your military, you will be incapacitated to live on, indeed even for a moment...

glosses.meaning: two of their, of king's, sons [princes Rama, Lakshmana]

glosses.itrans: muhuurtam api jiivitum na samarthaH hi
glosses.iast: muhūrtam api jīvitum na samarthaḥ hi
glosses.devanagari: मुहूर्तं अपि जीवितुं न समर्थः हि
glosses.meaning: moment, even, to live on, not, capacitated you are, indeed.

verses.devanagari:
न त्वम् तयोः शर स्पर्शम् सोढुम् शक्तः कथंचन |
वने प्रज्वलितस्य इव स्पर्शम् अग्नेः विहंगमः
verses.iast:
na tvam tayoḥ śara sparśam soḍhum śaktaḥ kathaṃcana |
vane prajvalitasya iva sparśam agneḥ vihaṃgamaḥ
verses.translation: "Anywise it will be incapable of you to endure the touch of their arrows, as with a bird that cannot endure the overly flaring up wildfire in a forest.
notes: Annex: 'After all, birds flee by the very touch of fiery air of forest fire even it is burning distantly... thus, where is the question of your tolerating those infernos, called my husband's arrows, shot from long, long a distance... and whereby you can stop them from hitting you, or with what you can retaliate them...'

glosses.meaning: in forest, overly, flaring up, of wildfire
to endure, in anywise, not, capable.

verses.devanagari:
साधु कृत्वा आत्मनः पथ्यम् साधु माम् मुंच रावण |
मत् प्रधर्षण रुष्टो हि भ्रात्रा सह पतिः मम
विधास्यति विनाशाय त्वम् माम् यदि न मुंचसि |
verses.iast:
sādhu kṛtvā ātmanaḥ pathyam sādhu mām muṃca rāvaṇa |
mat pradharṣaṇa ruṣṭo hi bhrātrā saha patiḥ mama
vidhāsyati vināśāya tvam mām yadi na muṃcasi |
verses.translation: "Oh, Ravana, positively contemplate in your soul and politely release me... and if you do not release me, indeed by the rancour of insulting me, my husband along with his brother devises your doom...
notes: All women, without exception, have a weapon called prathama kopam 'a preambular fury...' it is exactly not 'fury' but a sort of bewilderment and insultment meted out by their indignation. Seetha spewed out a stomachful of ire. Pausing a while, she now started to sermonise this demon with hita bodha 'moral teaching...' thinking in 'his' shoes and foreseeing 'his' annihilation. What and why does he care? And how does she bother for his well-being? These questions have their answers in mythology.

glosses.meaning: positively, in your soul, behove, on making [contemplate]
of my, by insulting, by rancour, indeed

verses.devanagari:
येन त्वम् व्यवसायेन बलात् माम् हर्तुम् इच्छसि
व्यवसायः तु ते नीच भविष्यति निरर्थकः |
verses.iast:
yena tvam vyavasāyena balāt mām hartum icchasi
vyavasāyaḥ tu te nīca bhaviṣyati nirarthakaḥ |
verses.translation: "You rogue! By which endeavour you are desirous of thieving me under duress, that endeavour of yours behoves absurd.
notes: Seetha's wording should have been 'for lovemaking with me...' instead of 'endeavour' but as an urbane lady, she used a + graamya pada prayoga, 'urbane' language rather than the graamya bhaaSa 'boorish wording.' Her calculated and cultured talking indicates her staunchness in her 'husband-devoutness...'

glosses.meaning: me, under duress, to thieve, desirous of

verses.devanagari:
न हि अहम् तम् अपश्यन्ती भर्तारम् विबुध उपमम्
उत्सहे शत्रु वशगा प्राणान् धारयितुम् चिरम् |
verses.iast:
na hi aham tam apaśyantī bhartāram vibudha upamam
utsahe śatru vaśagā prāṇān dhārayitum ciram |
verses.translation: "Though I am in aliveness now, but on my going under the control of an enemy and on unseeing godlike husband of mine I am indeed unenthused to bear up my lives for a long.
notes: Again she may recount her list of 'suicide programs' as related to Lakshmana after this dialogue. She prefers to use whatever means to end her life, rather than to surrender to immorality. To indicate this 'character's mood' pātra aucityam of Seetha, all her opinions about 'somebody's possessing her' were listed when Lakshmana was hastened after Rama, though at the cost of Lakshmana's steadfastness in his duty.

verses.devanagari:
न नूनम् च आत्मनः श्रेयः पथ्यम् वा समवेक्षसे
मृत्यु काले यथा मर्त्यो विपरीतानि सेवते |
verses.iast:
na nūnam ca ātmanaḥ śreyaḥ pathyam vā samavekṣase
mṛtyu kāle yathā martyo viparītāni sevate |
verses.translation: "Definitely and completely unanticipated in your heart are either that which is worthwhile or that which is beneficial to you, as mortals undertake a quirkily behaviour at the time of their death...

glosses.meaning: as, too much [noxious, non-recuperative foodstuffs, or, quirkily behaviour,] enjoys [undertakes]

verses.devanagari:
मुमूर्षूणाम् तु सर्वेषाम् यत् पथ्यम् तत् न रोचते
पश्यामि इव हि कण्ठे त्वाम् काल पाश अवपाशितम् |
verses.iast:
mumūrṣūṇām tu sarveṣām yat pathyam tat na rocate
paśyāmi iva hi kaṇṭhe tvām kāla pāśa avapāśitam |
verses.translation: "But which is recuperative that is unpalatable to all of the death-rattlers, and indeed, I behold you as one around whose throat the noose of Time is looped.

glosses.meaning: mortals about to die [death-rattlers,] but, to all of them
which, is recuperative, that, not, interested [unpalatable]

verses.devanagari:
यथा च अस्मिन् भय स्थाने न बिभेषि दशानन
व्यक्तम् हिरण्मयान् हि त्वम् संपश्यसि मही रुहान् |
verses.iast:
yathā ca asmin bhaya sthāne na bibheṣi daśānana
vyaktam hiraṇmayān hi tvam sampaśyasi mahī ruhān |
verses.translation: "As you are dauntless in this daunting situation as for yourself, oh, Decahedral demon, indeed it is clear that you are clearly fantasising the ill-omened golden trees all around.

verses.devanagari:
नदीम् वैतरणीम् घोराम् रुधिर ओघ विवाहिनीम्
खड्ग पत्र वनम् चैव भीमम् पश्यसि रावण |
verses.iast:
nadīm vaitaraṇīm ghorām rudhira ogha vivāhinīm
khaḍga patra vanam caiva bhīmam paśyasi rāvaṇa |
verses.translation: "Oh, Ravana, you will see the ghastly River Vaitarani which will be tumultuously streaming with blood streams, also thus you will see the grisly sword-leaved-forests in hell.

glosses.meaning: grisly, swords, leaved, forest, also thus

verses.devanagari:
तप्त कांचन पुष्पाम् च वैदूर्य प्रवर च्छदाम्
द्रक्ष्यसे शाल्मलीम् तीक्ष्णाम् आयसैः कण्टकैः चिताम् |
verses.iast:
tapta kāṃcana puṣpām ca vaidūrya pravara cchadām
drakṣyase śālmalīm tīkṣṇām āyasaiḥ kaṇṭakaiḥ citām |
verses.translation: "You will see silk-cotton trees flowered with molten gold, shrouded with lapis gemlike melting leaves, and enshrouded with sharp irony thorns in hell.
notes: Annex: Then Ravana may retort her by saying 'if such a condition comes, it comes after my death... but while living I will enjoy you and your company...' for this 'as on date enjoyment' of Ravana, she is repudiating him with her next statement... 'you have already quaffed off a venom, called Seetha... dwindled is your lifetime...'

This is a kind of punishment in a section called asi patra vana 'sword-leaved-forest...' in the Hell of Yama, namely naraka.. The sinners are asked to hug a silk-cotton tree like wooden structure with golden leaves and sappharine flowers and irony thorns, where all these items will be sweltering the sinners besides pinching and piercing with thorns. This punishment is aimed at those who abduct, molest, or rape the other man's wife.

glosses.meaning: [melting] lapis gemlike, best, shrouded [by lapis like leaves]

verses.devanagari:
न हि त्वम् ईदृशम् कृत्वा तस्य अलीकम् महात्मनः
धारितुम् शक्स्यसि चिरम् विषम् पीत्वा इव निर्घृणः |
verses.iast:
na hi tvam īdṛśam kṛtvā tasya alīkam mahātmanaḥ
dhāritum śaksyasi ciram viṣam pītvā iva nirghṛṇaḥ |
verses.translation: "Oh, unmerciful one, on doing this kind of misdeed to that noble-souled Rama you are incapable to bear up life for a long time like the one who quaffed venom.
notes: Then Ravana may say 'nonsense, these venoms, poisons, toxins... all these things can do nothing to me as I am immortalised, I take you off to a distant place, come what may...' for that Seetha is saying that 'the lasso of the Time is very long, but its noose is just throat sized and that noose is already noosed around your throat, called arm-length-sized arrow of Rama, already shot from his bowstring, called sting-like Seetha, as I am his and only his... as such, inescapable you are, anywhere you go...'

glosses.meaning: to that noble souled, to him - Rama
this kind of, misdeed, on doing
for a long, to bear up [to live,] not, capable of, indeed.

verses.devanagari:
बद्धः त्वम् काल पाशेन दुर्निवारेण रावण
क्व गतो लप्स्यसे शर्म भर्तुः मम महात्मनः |
verses.iast:
baddhaḥ tvam kāla pāśena dur.hnivāreṇa rāvaṇa
kva gato lapsyase śarma bhartuḥ mama mahātmanaḥ |
verses.translation: "You are bound by the unpreventable lasso of the Time, oh, Ravana, on going where you will get complacency from that uncompromising husband of mine?
notes: Ravana may say: 'is it? What is the proof of his mettle basing on which you sermonise me?' For this, her reply is in the next verse.

glosses.meaning: my, husband, from strong-willed one [uncompromising] Rama

verses.devanagari:
निमेष अन्तर मात्रेण विना भ्रातरम् आहवे
राक्षसा निहता येन सहस्राणि चतुर्दश |
कथम् स राघवो वीरः सर्व अस्त्र कुशलो बली
न त्वाम् हन्यात् शरैः तीक्ष्णैः इष्ट भार्या अपहारिणम् |
verses.iast:
nimeṣa antara mātreṇa vinā bhrātaram āhave
rākṣasā nihatā yena sahasrāṇi caturdaśa |
katham sa rāghavo vīraḥ sarva astra kuśalo balī
na tvām hanyāt śaraiḥ tīkṣṇaiḥ iṣṭa bhāryā apahāriṇam |
verses.translation: "By whom fourteen thousand demons are killed in war just within a minute, single-handedly without any help from his brother, how then that brave and mighty Raghava, an expert in all kinds of missiles, will not eliminate you, the stealer of his chosen wife, with his mordant arrows?" Thus Seetha poured forth her ire at Ravana.

glosses.meaning: in all kinds of, missiles, expert

verses.devanagari:
एतत् च अन्यत् च परुषम् वैदेही रावण अंक गा |
भय शोक समाविष्टा करुणम् विललाप ह
verses.iast:
etat ca anyat ca paruṣam vaidehī rāvaṇa aṃka gā |
bhaya śoka samāviṣṭā karuṇam vilalāpa ha
verses.translation: On saying this much and other exacting words, Vaidehi who has gone onto the flank of Ravana, indeed lamented lamentably as her dismay is coalesced with her distress. [3-53-25b, c]

glosses.meaning: this much, also, other, also, sharp [saying exacting words]

verses.devanagari:
तथा भृश आर्ताम् बहु चैव भाषिणीम्
विललाप पूर्वम् करुणम् च भामिनीम् |
जहार पापः तरुणीम् विवेष्टतीम्
नृपात्मजाम् आगत गात्र वेपथुम्
verses.iast:
tathā bhṛśa ārtām bahu caiva bhāṣiṇīm
vilalāpa pūrvam karuṇam ca bhāminīm |
jahāra pāpaḥ taruṇīm viveṣṭatīm
nṛpātmajām āgata gātra vepathum
verses.translation: She who is highly agonised and weeping before talking, a ranter who ranted much, a resentful lady who has come of age, and a pitiable whirler in the hands of demon whose whirligig has transformed into spasmodic jerking of her body for deliverance from that sinner, and in that way that sinner stole that princess Seetha.

glosses.meaning: lamenting, prioritised - weeping prior to talking
